track_b.name: XCU_AND_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPMENT
track_b.delta: typed Xeno Entry Fabric plus reusable deterministic GRID10 logical-cell scheduler with logical cell count separated from physical worker budget

hypothesis: Binding immutable causal event identity before cognition and hashing that event identity into route decisions prevents materially different events from aliasing merely because they choose the same routing result, while preserving deterministic replay of the same event.
counterhypothesis: A simpler payload-only or routing-output-only identity is sufficient and full typed event binding adds complexity without improving causal replay/audit reliability.
cheapest_discriminator: route two distinct provenance events with identical payload/routing output and compare weak payload-only identity against the proposed immutable event identity; separately replay the same event with a later transport receipt time.
verified_invariants: same causal event replay with changed received_at preserves event_sha256 and route_decision_sha256 while ingress_id changes
materially different events selecting the same cells produce different route decision digests
effect_request without explicit capability scope fails closed
logical GRID10 cell count is reported separately from physical worker budget
runtime output declares NONE_CANDIDATE_ONLY effect authority
next_discriminator: wire XenoIngressPacket/event_sha256 into the retained HCU reactive router route-decision identity and then into the canonical state admission path; execute exact integration regressions before merging any provider-independence/causal-route claim from PR 1263.
